content.title: Dhurandhar 2 Worldwide Box Office Collection: Ranveer Singh’s Film Breaks All Bollywood Records Including Baah
content.text: Aditya Dhar directorial Dhurandhar: The Revenge finally released on the big screens on March 19, 2026. Netizens, who watched the movie, including the paid previews, have taken to their social media handles to share their reviews and opinions for the film. Now, with the first day over, the movie’s worldwide box office collection is making the headlines. The much-awaited spy thriller is all set to emerge as one of the biggest Indian films in recent times. According to Hindustan Times, the sequel of the 2025 film got a good headstart on Wednesday, as the paid previews earned Rs 42 crore net domestically and Rs 75 crore gross worldwide. This reportedly led to the film crossing Rs 100 crore gross on early Thursday morning. SEE ALSO: Rupee Hits Historic Low Against Dollar At 93 Amid Energy Crisis; Internet Reacts With Hilarious Dhurandhar Memes Since then, the film has also been released in tier-2 and tier-3 cities, which has led to it expanding its earnings across the country. On Thursday, the movie made a total collection of Rs 102 crore net domestically, taking its total earnings to Rs 145 crore net and Rs 172 crore gross, after a single day in theatres. The festive holidays for Ugadi and Gudi Padwa have held the film’s box office collection. Internationally, too, Dhurandhar 2 has managed to earn almost $7 million on Thursday. This has taken the movie’s overseas haul to over $9 million. All in all, the Ranveer Singh starrer has earned around Rs 240 crore gross worldwide on its opening day, including Rs 165 crore on the day alone. SEE ALSO: ‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’ Review: Ranveer Singh, Arjun Rampal, And Sanjay Dutt Fuel Explosive Act That’s Thrilling, Violent, And Manipulative It is to be noted that the Dhurandhar: The Revenge has broken the highest opening by a Bollywood film record, which was previously held by Shah Rukh Khan’s Jawan (2023), with an earning of Rs 129 crore. Other films that earned over Rs 100 crore on their opening day are Pathan (Rs 104 crore) and Animal (Rs 101 crore). Globally, it has also surpassed the records set by some of the biggest pan-Indian films of the last decade, including RRR (Rs 223 crore), Baahubali 2 (Rs 214 crore), Kalki 2898 AD (Rs 174 crore), and KGF Chapter 2 (Rs 159 crore). Directed by Aditya Dhar, Dhurandhar stars Ranveer Singh, Sanjay Dutt, Akshaye Khanna, Sara Arjun, R. Madhavan, and Arjun Rampal. Released on December 5, 2025, the second part of the film, officially titled Dhurandhar: The Revenge, will be released in theatres on March 19, 2026. It will be released in multiple languages, including Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam.
